item.title: Shercock-Cootehill Rd closed following collision
item.description: The R192 in Co Cavan has been closed following a two vehicle collision. Emergency services are at the scene which is located near Lough Tacker about 6kms from Shercock. Advertisement It’s understood that the collision occurred sometime after 9am this morning. The road between Shercock and Cootehill is now closed and is expected to be closed for a number of hours. item.title: Tributes pour in for the late Jimmie Brady
item.description: Tributes are being paid to Co Cavan businessman Jimmie Brady who has passed away. The former proprietor of White Horse Hotel in Cootehill was a formidable force in the Co Cavan business landscape for a number of decades. In a tribute paid online, a former employee of Mr Brady said it was an honour to work under such a 'dedicated leader'. item.title: Date set for Jeffrey Donaldson trial
item.description: A date has finally been set for the Jeffrey Donaldson trial. The former DUP leader is charged with historical sex offences - while his wife Eleanor is charged with aiding and abetting offences - which they deny. The trial has faced delays because of issues surrounding Ms. Donaldson's health - but in court today, it was confirmed a start date of Tuesday the 26th of May has been agreed. It's expected to last up to four weeks. Advertisement

item.title: Salons in counties Monaghan and Cavan offer most expensive haircuts locally
item.description: Hairdressers are expected to increase their prices, with counties Roscommon, Cavan and Monaghan found to be the most expensive in the region for a men's cut. An Irish Independent survey of 151 independent salons published today reveal the price currently stands at an average of €17.50 in the three counties. Meanwhile, the cost is lower in Co. item.title: Man (40s) dies following two-vehicle collision in Co. Cavan
item.description: Gardaí are appealing for witnesses following a fatal road traffic collision that occurred in Shercock Co. Cavan on Monday 2nd February 2026. Shortly before 7:30am Emergency Services and Gardaí responded to a collision involving a car and a lorry on the R192 at Corcloughan, Shercock. The driver of the car, a male in his 40s, was pronounced deceased at the scene a short time later. The lorry driver, a male in his 60s, was taken to hospital for assessment. item.title: Oran England to launch 2026 season with exclusive Peugeot support
item.description: Cavan-based rally driver Oran England; will officially launch his 2026 motorsport campaign at Lough Owel Peugeot in Mullingar on Friday, February 6. The 2026 programme will see the former two-time Irish Karting Champion tackle the Motorsport Ireland Junior Rally Series (MIJRS). This series is designed to test young drivers across both gravel and tarmac surfaces. Offering the overall winner a prestigious nomination for the Billy Coleman Award. item.title: Road reopens following fatal Co Cavan collision
item.description: The R192 at Corcloughan, Shercock has reopened following a fatal collision this morning. Gardaí are appealing for witnesses following the collision that occurred in Shercock shortly after 7.30am. The road was closed throughout the day pending a technical examination by Garda Forensic Collision Investigators.
